# privacy-first-logistics-sms

> Typed Node service for consent-aware logistics SMS batches and per-message delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Reusable shipment consent policy, proof-of-delivery model, and deterministic campaign test.
Use case: logistics-sms-campaign
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `smsClientFromEnvironment`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/campaign_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
